issue.title: Close-outcome letter aliases (x → !, s → *) in Bob Mac Capture
issue.description: In the Bob Mac Capture editor, a plain lowercase `x` typed where a close selection accepts an outcome marker becomes `!`, and a plain lowercase `s` becomes `*`. Examples: `xx` → `x!`, `xs` → `x*`, `x1s` → `x1*`, `x=1=s` → `x=1=*`, and `@r:id=xx` → `@r:id=x!`. Bob's `capture-rewrite` alone decides where the alias fires. `bob capture`, `capture-parse`, paste, and CLI text keep the letters. Typing speed never changes the outcome: keys typed before Bob answers are held and replayed, and a fast Return never files the literal draft.

issue.title: Bob capture-rewrite close-outcome alias
issue.description: bob-close-alias: add an x/s branch to the expand_sigil_alias rule in bob-cli capture-rewrite. It locates a close slot on the draft before the key, then checks the swapped selection with the close lexer. Ships with unit and CLI tests, capture-rewrite help, and capture docs as a non-breaking feat(capture).

issue.title: Mac type-ahead hold for meaning-changing rewrite aliases
issue.description: mac-type-ahead-hold: generalize the past-segment dash Return deferral into a meaning-changing-alias flag. Add a bounded type-ahead hold that buffers key-downs while such a rewrite is in flight and replays them after Bob answers. Its first client is the existing x= dash alias. Mac only.

issue.title: Mac forwards x/s to Bob's close-outcome alias
issue.description: mac-close-alias: forward lowercase non-repeat x/s keys through a lexical send prefilter into the rewrite lane, mark them meaning-changing so the hold and Return deferral cover them, and add a one-time old-bob probe. Adds recorded fixtures, tests, Mac docs, the optional decision record, and an end-to-end check.
